requiredBehaviors.behavior: record semantic workflow transitions as linked events with canonical input output evidence references
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Document-on-transition Gate and Event-Modell require linked canonical inputs, outputs, decisions and evidence for substantive workflow transitions.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: reuse or materialize one canonical Google Drive project folder for non-textual documentary and delivery artifacts

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: invent Drive folder or file identifiers URLs or verification state
